name: session-tts
description: Read Codex responses aloud locally with a different Japanese voice per session. Instructs Codex to deliver mid-turn progress narration via a synchronous Bash call into the say adapter. Permission prompts include the workspace name. ON by default; playback volume is adjustable via /session-tts:volume. Engine and models are managed automatically. Apple Silicon only.

author.name: Suguru Inatomi (ported to Codex by yuta)
